title: GET /api/bot/signals serves timestamp '' and a fresh uuid id on every row: map the writer's real time key (PI-20261011-JPFINTEQ-0001)
note: [2026-10-18 lane RESEARCH-AUTHOR-GRADE-1017] Owns PI-20261011-JPFINTEQ-0001 (found by UI-UPGRADE-1). ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED FROM CODE on main: src/utils/signal_audit_logger.py:55 log_signal stamps payload.setdefault('logged_at_utc', ...) and no 'ts'/'timestamp'; src/web/api/routers/dashboard.py:996-1025 get_signals reads e.get('ts', e.get('timestamp','')) and id e.get('id', str(uuid.uuid4())), so every row serves '' and a new uuid. Second defect (from the item, not re-measured): it tails 50 raw lines of which only ~2 are buy/sell, so scan back until N signals. Fix: read logged_at_utc (fallback ts/timestamp), derive a stable id (hash of logged_at_utc+strategy+symbol+side), tail until N signals, with a test. Tier-1 read path, but deployed API: ship through the web-api deploy. Closes when /api/bot/signals returns non-empty timestamps and stable ids across two calls.
